## Goals
This is an updated section of data_3_workflow.Rmd that corresponds to folder 
`Daphne/Floral_metagenoimcs/data_4-fixing-ortholog-trees`. This notebook contains
part 14 of data_3 workflow, the "Blast Orthologs of pectin lyase". I am picking 
up from 4 months ago when the trees were wonky


## Steps

Previously done in data_3_workflow.Rmd:

1.  FastQC quality analysis
2.  Trimmomatic adapter trimming
3.  bowtie filter with all host plants
4.  MetaSpades assembly
5.  MetaQuast check quality assessment of both
6.  megabat2



NOTE: I copied folders data_3/04_metaspades to the data_4-trees directory to run the following code in data_4-trees

### Blast PL Orthologs with RAST reference
I will use the same pipeline as above (14.1-14.5) to create a new tree, but with the RAST references

#### 14.1: RAST reference proteins

I went to RAST and for all Acinetobacter pollinis and nectaris, I searched their
pectin lyase and polygalacturonase using methods from Benchling's 
`Metagenomic ortholog pectin lyase tree Vivi's 2021 data`

3/20/26: I'm making sure ESL, CIP, and MD18 are added


1. Dowload Vivi's tree RAST orthologs

*How to dowload RAST orthologs*
  1. log into RAST, and click "Your Jobs", to get list of all genomes
  2. in the spreadsheet, go to the "Name" column's search bar, and search for 
  genome. click on "view details" for your genome
  3. Once inside that genome's page, click on link "» Browse annotated genome 
  in SEED Viewer"
  4. Once in annotated seed viewer, click on link "Browse through the features 
  of Acinetobacter xxxxxxxxx1"
  5. Once in features page, scroll to the spreadsheet, go to the "Function" 
  column's search bar and type "pectin lyase". Only a few searches should appear,
  and click on "Feature annotation" link your ortholog
  6. Once in the ortholog page, click on "internal links" link  "sequence"
  7. Once in the fasta sequence page, click "download sequences"
  8. Once downloaded on my computer, I like to rename the file 
  "A.(species)(strain).peg(number). Ex: "A-nectaris-EC34.469.257.peg.84



the references are in `14_blast_orthologs/1_references_and_outgroups/RAST_pectin_lyase/all_PL_ref_fastas.fasta`



### PECTIN LYASE crop and filtered pipeline 1/14

####14.2 BLASTN for metagenome

```{bash}
    
cd /local/workdir/Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/data_4-trees
    
tree_name="PL_cropped_RAST_Mar23_metagenome"
for sample in 04_metaspades/*; do   
    # Input
    query_nucleotides="14_blast_orthologs/1_references_and_outgroups/RAST_pectin_lyase/all_PL_ref_fastas.fasta"
  
    # Output directories
    OUTDIR="14_blast_orthologs/2_ortholog_search/$(basename "$sample")/${tree_name}"
    
    echo "[INFO] Step 1: Building BLAST database..."
    makeblastdb -in ${sample}/contigs.fasta -dbtype nucl -out $OUTDIR/metagenome_db
    
    echo "[INFO] Step 2: Running BLASTN..."
    blastn -query $query_nucleotides -db $OUTDIR/metagenome_db \
           -out $OUTDIR/tblastn_results.tsv \
           -evalue 1e-5 -num_threads 30 \
           -task blastn \
           -outfmt '6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore'
    
    echo "[INFO] Step 3: Filtering BLAST hits..."
    awk '$3 >= 60 && $4 >= 250 && $11 <= 1e-50' $OUTDIR/tblastn_results.tsv > $OUTDIR/blast_results.filtered.tsv
      # this step filters tblastn_results above a high-quality threshold of 
    echo "[INFO] Done."
    
     echo "[INFO] Step 4: deduplicating hits (keep highest bit score)..."
     tsv="$OUTDIR/blast_results.filtered.tsv"
     awk '
      {
          if (!best[$2] || $12 > best[$2]) {
              best[$2] = $12
              line[$2] = $0
          }
      }
      END {
          for (c in line)
              print line[c]
      }' "$tsv" > "$tsv.unique"
    
done
# takes 2 minutes

#SANITY CHECK: print tsv of all filtered orthologs
Sanity_output="14_blast_orthologs/2_ortholog_search/all_${tree_name}.tsv"
for subdir in 14_blast_orthologs/2_ortholog_search/*FN*; do
  if [ -s ${subdir}/${tree_name}/blast_results.filtered.tsv.unique ]; then
  echo "$(basename "${subdir}")" >> $Sanity_output
  cat ${subdir}/${tree_name}/blast_results.filtered.tsv.unique >> $Sanity_output
  fi
done
  # took 1 min
  
```  

####14.3 for metagenome
```{bash}
  
tree_name="PL_cropped_RAST_Mar23_metagenome"
OUT_FASTA="14_blast_orthologs/3_orthologs_from_all_samples/${tree_name}.fasta"

echo "" > $OUT_FASTA
for sample in 04_metaspades/*; do   
BLAST_TSV="14_blast_orthologs/2_ortholog_search/$(basename "$sample")/${tree_name}/blast_results.filtered.tsv.unique"
CONTIGS_FASTA="${sample}/contigs.fasta"

# Read each line of BLAST TSV
while IFS=$'\t' read -r qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore
do
    #save the sample name in a variable:
    sample_name=$(basename "$sample")
    # Determine start and end in increasing order
    if [ "$sstart" -le "$send" ]; then
        START="$sstart"
        END="$send"
        STRAND="+"
    else
        START="$send"
        END="$sstart"
        STRAND="-"
    fi

    # Extract sequence using awk
    SEQ=$(awk -v seqid="$sseqid" -v start="$START" -v end="$END" '
        BEGIN {capture=0; seq=""}
        /^>/ {capture=($0 ~ ">"seqid); next}
        capture {seq=seq $0}
        END {print substr(seq, start, end-start+1)}
    ' "$CONTIGS_FASTA")

    # Reverse complement if needed
    if [ "$STRAND" = "-" ]; then
        SEQ=$(echo "$SEQ" | rev | tr 'ACGTacgt' 'TGCAtgca')
    fi

    # Print to output FASTA with sample name
    echo ">${sample_name}_${sseqid}:${START}-${END}(${STRAND})" >> "$OUT_FASTA"
    # Wrap sequence at 80 chars per line
    echo "$SEQ" | fold -w 80 >> "$OUT_FASTA"

done < "$BLAST_TSV"
done

```

#### 14.4 aligning with MAFFT (both metagenome and new genomes)

Now, I will align the references, outgroups, metagenomic, AND new genomes together
into one big tree, so the cat step will include new-genomes too (line 546)

```{bash MAFFT, eval = FALSE}

#BEFORE USING MAFFT:
#I combined orthologs reference and outgroup fastas from `14_blast_orthologs/1_references_and_outgroups` together with our samples from `14_blast_orthologs/3_3_orthologs_from_all_samples` with cat:

tree_name="PL_cropped_RAST_Mar23"
"" > 14_blast_orthologs/3_orthologs_from_all_samples/${tree_name}_PLUS_references_and_outgroups.fasta
cat 14_blast_orthologs/1_references_and_outgroups/RAST_pectin_lyase/all_PL_ref_PLUS_outgroups.fasta \
14_blast_orthologs/3_orthologs_from_all_samples/PL_cropped_RAST_Mar23_metagenome.fasta \
14_blast_orthologs/3_orthologs_from_all_samples/PL_cropped_RAST_Mar23_newgenome.fasta \
>> 14_blast_orthologs/3_orthologs_from_all_samples/${tree_name}_PLUS_references_and_outgroups.fasta


export PATH=/programs/mafft/bin:$PATH
cd /local/workdir/Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/data_4-trees

/programs/mafft/bin/mafft --auto --nuc --thread 30 \
14_blast_orthologs/3_orthologs_from_all_samples/${tree_name}_PLUS_references_and_outgroups.fasta > \
14_blast_orthologs/4_aligned_orthologs_MAFFT/${tree_name}.aln
  # took under 1 min
  
# --auto: chooses best strat for this data, which is FFT-NS-i (standard)
# -nuc: assume input is nucleotides
# --thread: to go faster 


```
PECTIN LYASE and POLYGALACTURONASE STRATEGY:
FFT-NS-i (Standard)
 Iterative refinement method (max. 2 iterations)


#### 14.5 IQ tree
```{bash}
cd /local/workdir/Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/data_4-trees

tree_name="PL_cropped_RAST_Mar23"
#name this tree
mkdir 14_blast_orthologs/5_IQ_tree/${tree_name}
/programs/iqtree-2.2.2.6-Linux/bin/iqtree2 -s 14_blast_orthologs/4_aligned_orthologs_MAFFT/${tree_name}.aln -m MFP \
--prefix 14_blast_orthologs/5_IQ_tree/${tree_name}/${tree_name} -B 1000 --seed 713


# -s: input
# -m MFP: modelfinder plus, fo finding right phylo model (Vivi used SYM+R10)
# --prefix: change output destination/name
# -B: bootstrap
# -nt: thread number
#--redo (OPTIONAL): overwrite current tree
# --seed 713

#took 1 min 
```

###BLAST SEARCH FOR OTHER ACINETO GENOMES

March 9, 2026: I am coming back to this workflow because I have many genome fasta files here, and I want to use blast+ to search NCBI database for Acinetobacter that may
not be classified as such or annotated.

```{bash}

# Download NCBI database into /Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/databases/NCBI
cd /local/workdir/Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/databases
mkdir BLAST_nr
cp /shared_data/genome_db/BLAST_NCBI/nr* BLAST_nr/

```


```{bash}
# Blast search with a genome

cd /local/workdir/Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/data_4-trees/New_NY_Acineto_genomes


database="/local/workdir/Daphne/Floral_metagenomics/databases/BLAST_nr/nr"

```
